decision.explanation: The original source D2S2 explicitly states 'Sony has announced that God of War will be released for PS4 on April 20, 2018.' This matches the requested relation (release date) and referent (God of War (2018)). The R5 answer aligns with this and is supported by the same source. Other dates like Jan 23, 2018 or April 2, 2011 appear either in unrelated contexts or refer to different titles/versions and are not relevant to the specific question about God of War (2018).
